records.text: A trusted confidential source told Candace Owens that Erika Kirk was on a three-way phone call with Andrew Kolvet and a surgeon, and that the 'Superman' quotation came from Erika Kirk rather than the surgeon.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #4 (Ep OEAHy3SsIiI)

appearances.snippet: according to my source, which I trust very much, the person that was on that phone that said that quote was actually Erika (Erika Kirk). ... It was a three-way phone call. ... My source says that no, the surgeon did not violate HIPAA and he never said that. But he answered Andrew Kolvet's questions because Erika (Erika Kirk) was on the phone and that the Superman quotation came from her
